title: Scams on Claims Investigated since Implementation of SkillsFuture
what_it_is: Scams on Claims Investigated since Implementation of SkillsFuture

sections.label: SSG action against training providers
sections.summary: SSG issued advisory, warning and suspension letters to 27 training providers who breached marketing guidelines, and conducts random audits.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: SSG has set in place specific marketing guidelines for training providers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: It has issued advisory, warning and suspension letters to 27 training providers who have breached these guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: These errant organisations have been warned some have been suspended.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: SSG regularly conducts random ground audits to check compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: The agency welcomes feedback from members of the public who spot or suspect any malpractice.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: We want to reiterate that SSG, the Ministry of Education and the Government have zero tolerance for any attempt by individuals, training providers or organisations to abuse its funding schemes that serve the interest of Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: SSG will not hesitate to act against such errant individuals or organisations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Out of the 27 training providers, some have been suspended.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: But we want to assure Er Dr Lee Bee Wah and all Members that we take a very serious view of any abuse and SSG is strengthening its efforts on all fronts to uphold the goals of SkillsFuture for the benefit of many Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: And training providers who breach  these guidelines like the 27, will be dealt with with a very severe warning and in some cases, suspended, or even heavy actions.
